bets.thesis: We believe rebuilding registration end to end — mobile-first, multi-kid, with payment in the flow — lifts completed enrollments, because the current flow loses families at exactly the point they have decided to buy.
bets.whyNow: Registration is the first thing every camp and every family touches, so it is both the biggest conversion lever and the proof that modernization is real. It also gates Summer '27 enrollment: miss the window and the next chance is a year out.

outcomes.statement: Completed registrations on the modern flow

bets.killCriteria: Modern registration does not reach GA in time for Summer '27 enrollment opening, or completion rate fails to beat the legacy flow across a full cycle.
bets.title: Registration
bets.description: Umbrella bet modernizing registration end to end — forms, payment, and additional options/sessions — coordinated across teams.

bets.title: Parent Experience Convergence
bets.description: Merging Camp inTouch and Campanion into one parent app. No single team owns it: the dashboard and convergence phases sit on Community Engagement, but forms belong to Custom Fields, balances to Payments, registration status to Registrations and household to People & Orgs.
